title: DFT Engineer
description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus. Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type). MBIST and memory repair integration. JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers. ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement. DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks. Test-mode SDC / STA understanding. Scripting: Tcl, Python. Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug. Language: English at a proficient level. Responsibilities Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team. Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off. Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks. Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure. Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up. Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house. Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow. Preferred Qualification Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below). Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs. Hierarchical DFT on large designs. Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch. Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure. Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight). Pay and benefits Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions. Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers). Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays. Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
